column1: ARE|Burj Khalifa|Dubai's Burj Khalifa became the world's tallest building in 2010.
ARE|United Arab Emirates|Seven emirates make up this country, formed as a federation in 1971.
ARE|Emirates Mars Mission|Its Hope probe entered orbit around Mars in 2021.
ARG|Lionel Messi|Lionel Messi grew up in Rosario and captained this country to the 2022 men's World Cup title.
ARG|Eva Perón|Eva Perón, the political figure behind the musical Evita, was its first lady.
ARG|Tango|Along with Uruguay, this country helped give the world tango.
AUS|Sydney Opera House|Its best-known opera house has a roof often compared to sails.
AUS|Steve Irwin|Wildlife presenter Steve Irwin became famous as the Crocodile Hunter here.
AUS|AC/DC|The rock band AC/DC formed in Sydney in this country.
AUT|Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart|Mozart was born in Salzburg, in what is now this country.
AUT|The Sound of Music (film)|The Sound of Music follows the von Trapp family in this country.
AUT|Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria|Vienna was the seat of the Habsburg rulers; the assassination of heir Franz Ferdinand helped spark World War I.
BGD|Bangladesh Liberation War|This country became independent from Pakistan after a war in 1971.
BGD|Muhammad Yunus|Muhammad Yunus and Grameen Bank won the Nobel Peace Prize for work on microcredit here.
BGD|Bengali language movement|A movement defending Bengali helped inspire International Mother Language Day.
BRA|Pelé|Pelé won three men's World Cups playing for this country.
BRA|Rio Carnival|Rio de Janeiro hosts its famous carnival of samba schools and parades.
BRA|Bossa nova|The musical style bossa nova developed here; The Girl from Ipanema became a worldwide hit.
CAN|Celine Dion|Céline Dion was born in Quebec in this country.
CAN|Toronto Raptors|The Toronto Raptors became the first NBA champions based outside the United States.
CAN|Terry Fox|Terry Fox attempted to run across this country to raise money for cancer research.
CHL|Pablo Neruda|Nobel Prize-winning poet Pablo Neruda came from this country.
CHL|2010 Copiapó mining accident|The world watched as 33 trapped miners were rescued here in 2010.
CHL|Easter Island|Rapa Nui, famous for its giant moai statues, is part of this country.
CHN|Terracotta Army|Thousands of terracotta soldiers guarded the tomb of its first emperor.
CHN|Great Wall of China|A vast network of defensive walls stretches across its northern landscape.
CHN|Mao Zedong|Mao Zedong proclaimed its People's Republic in 1949.
COL|Shakira|Shakira was born in Barranquilla in this country.
COL|Gabriel García Márquez|Gabriel García Márquez, author of One Hundred Years of Solitude, was born here.
COL|Encanto|Disney's Encanto is set in this country.
CZE|Velvet Revolution|The peaceful Velvet Revolution ended communist rule in its predecessor state in 1989.
CZE|Franz Kafka|Franz Kafka was born in Prague, now this country's capital.
CZE|Pilsner Urquell|The golden lager style called pilsner began in the city of Plzeň here.
DEU|Fall of the Berlin Wall|A wall dividing its best-known city opened in November 1989.
DEU|Ludwig van Beethoven|Beethoven was born in Bonn, in what is now this country.

DNK|The Lego Group|LEGO began as a small workshop in Billund in this country.
DNK|Hans Christian Andersen|Hans Christian Andersen wrote The Little Mermaid and The Ugly Duckling here.

EGY|Tutankhamun|The discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb made headlines around the world.
EGY|Suez Canal|The Suez Canal links the Mediterranean and Red Sea through this country.
EGY|Cleopatra|Cleopatra VII was its last active Ptolemaic ruler.
ESP|Pablo Picasso|Picasso was born in Málaga in this country.
ESP|Don Quixote|Cervantes set Don Quixote's windmill-tilting adventures here.

FRA|French Revolution|The storming of the Bastille became a symbol of its 1789 revolution.
FRA|Napoleon|Napoleon rose from army officer to emperor of this country.
FRA|Tour de France|The world's most famous multi-stage bicycle race is chiefly held here.
GBR|The Beatles|The Beatles formed in Liverpool in this country.
GBR|William Shakespeare|William Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon-Avon here.
GBR|Winston Churchill|Winston Churchill led its government through much of World War II.
GHA|Kwame Nkrumah|Kwame Nkrumah led this country to independence from Britain in 1957.
GHA|Kofi Annan|Former UN secretary-general Kofi Annan was born in Kumasi here.
GHA|Kente cloth|Its brightly patterned kente cloth is woven in strips and often worn for celebrations.
GRC|Ancient Olympic Games|The ancient Olympic Games began at Olympia here.

GRC|Mamma Mia! (film)|The film Mamma Mia! used islands such as Skopelos for its seaside setting.
HRV|2018 FIFA World Cup final|Luka Modrić captained this country to the 2018 men's World Cup final.
HRV|Game of Thrones|Dubrovnik's walls stood in for King's Landing in Game of Thrones.
HRV|Nikola Tesla|Nikola Tesla was born in Smiljan, a village in what is now this country.
HUN|Ernő Rubik|The inventor of the Rubik's Cube, Ernő Rubik, came from this country.
HUN|Hungarian Revolution of 1956|Soviet forces crushed an uprising in its capital in 1956.
HUN|Harry Houdini|Escape artist Harry Houdini was born in Budapest here.
IDN|Komodo dragon|Wild Komodo dragons live on a handful of islands in this country.
IDN|Proclamation of Indonesian Independence|Sukarno and Mohammad Hatta proclaimed its independence in 1945.
IDN|Bali|The island of Bali is one of its best-known destinations.
IND|Mahatma Gandhi|Gandhi's campaigns of nonviolent resistance helped it win independence from Britain.
IND|Hindi cinema|Mumbai is the center of the Hindi film industry nicknamed Bollywood.
IND|Taj Mahal|An emperor built the Taj Mahal here as a tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
IRL|U2|The rock band U2 formed in Dublin here.
IRL|James Joyce|James Joyce set Ulysses in its capital.
IRL|Guinness|The Guinness brewery began at St James's Gate in its capital.
IRN|Iranian Revolution|A revolution overthrew the shah here in 1979.
IRN|Persepolis|The ruins of Persepolis recall the Achaemenid Persian Empire here.
IRN|A Separation|Asghar Farhadi's A Separation won this country its first Oscar for a foreign-language film.
ITA|Leonardo da Vinci|Leonardo da Vinci was born near Vinci, in what is now this country.
ITA|Colosseum|Gladiators once fought in the Colosseum in its capital.
ITA|Ferrari|Enzo Ferrari founded his famous sports-car company here.
JOR|Petra|Its rock-cut city of Petra appeared in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade.
JOR|The Martian (film)|Wadi Rum's desert stood in for Mars in The Martian.
JOR|Dead Sea|This country has an eastern shore on the Dead Sea.
JPN|Nintendo|Nintendo began in Kyoto as a maker of playing cards.
JPN|Studio Ghibli|Studio Ghibli made Spirited Away and My Neighbor Totoro here.
JPN|Hiroshima|Hiroshima and Nagasaki were struck by atomic bombs in 1945.
KEN|Eliud Kipchoge|Marathon runner Eliud Kipchoge represents this country.
KEN|Wangarĩ Maathai|Wangari Maathai founded the Green Belt Movement here and won the Nobel Peace Prize.
KEN|Maasai Mara|Its Maasai Mara reserve is famous for lions and migrating wildebeest.
KHM|Angkor Wat|Angkor Wat, a vast temple complex, appears on its national flag.
KHM|Khmer Rouge|Pol Pot's Khmer Rouge regime ruled this country in the 1970s.
KHM|Lara Croft: Tomb Raider|The temple of Ta Prohm here was a filming location for Lara Croft: Tomb Raider.
KOR|BTS|BTS and BLACKPINK helped bring this country's pop music to a worldwide audience.
KOR|Parasite (2019 film)|Parasite became the first non-English-language film to win the Best Picture Oscar.
KOR|Squid Game|The television series Squid Game was made in this country.
LKA|Ceylon tea|Tea from this island is still widely sold under its former name, Ceylon.
LKA|1996 Cricket World Cup final|Its men's cricket team won the 1996 World Cup, beating Australia in the final.
LKA|Sirimavo Bandaranaike|Sirimavo Bandaranaike became the world's first woman prime minister here.
MAR|2022 FIFA World Cup|Its men's football team became Africa's first World Cup semifinalist in 2022.
MAR|Casablanca (film)|The classic film Casablanca is named after a city in this country.
MAR|Ibn Battuta|The great medieval traveler Ibn Battuta was born in Tangier here.
MEX|Frida Kahlo|Frida Kahlo painted self-portraits at her Blue House here.
MEX|Day of the Dead|Families remember loved ones with colorful Day of the Dead offerings here.
MEX|Chichen Itza|The Maya built the great stepped pyramid at Chichén Itzá here.
MYS|Petronas Towers|Kuala Lumpur's twin Petronas Towers became a symbol of this country.
MYS|Michelle Yeoh|Oscar-winning actor Michelle Yeoh was born in Ipoh here.

NOR|Edvard Munch|Edvard Munch, the artist behind The Scream, came from this country.

NOR|A-ha|The band a-ha, known for Take On Me, formed here.
NPL|Mount Everest|Mount Everest rises on its border with China.
NPL|The Buddha|Lumbini, traditionally recognized as the Buddha's birthplace, is here.
NPL|Gurkha|Gurkha soldiers take their name from the town of Gorkha in this country.
NZL|The Lord of the Rings (film series)|Peter Jackson filmed his Lord of the Rings trilogy here.
NZL|New Zealand national rugby union team|Its All Blacks rugby team performs a haka before matches.
NZL|Women's suffrage in New Zealand|In 1893 it became the first self-governing country to give women the vote in parliamentary elections.
OMN|Frankincense|Its Dhofar region is famous for the ancient frankincense trade.
OMN|Qaboos bin Said|Sultan Qaboos ruled this country from 1970 until 2020.
OMN|Strait of Hormuz|Its Musandam peninsula helps form the southern side of the Strait of Hormuz.
PAK|Malala Yousafzai|Education campaigner Malala Yousafzai was born in Mingora here.
PAK|1992 Cricket World Cup final|Imran Khan captained this country to the 1992 men's Cricket World Cup title.
PAK|Mohenjo-daro|The ancient Indus Valley city of Mohenjo-daro is here.
PER|Machu Picchu|The Inca built Machu Picchu high in its Andes mountains.
PER|Nazca lines|Huge ancient figures called the Nazca Lines are etched into its desert.
PER|Paddington Bear|Paddington Bear is said to come from this country.
POL|Marie Curie|Marie Curie was born in Warsaw, now this country's capital.
POL|Solidarity (Polish trade union)|Lech Wałęsa and the Solidarity movement challenged communist rule here.
POL|Frédéric Chopin|Composer Frédéric Chopin was born near Warsaw here.
PRT|Cristiano Ronaldo|Cristiano Ronaldo was born on Madeira, an island belonging to this country.
PRT|Vasco da Gama|Vasco da Gama sailed from here to India around the Cape of Good Hope.
PRT|Carnation Revolution|The Carnation Revolution ended its dictatorship in 1974.
ROU|Dracula|Bram Stoker's Dracula made its region of Transylvania famous around the world.
ROU|Nadia Comăneci|Nadia Comăneci earned the first perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics for this country.
ROU|Romanian revolution|A revolution overthrew Nicolae Ceaușescu here in 1989.
SEN|Sadio Mané|Footballer Sadio Mané helped this country win its first Africa Cup of Nations title.
SEN|Léopold Sédar Senghor|Poet Léopold Sédar Senghor became its first president after independence.
SEN|Dakar Rally|The original Paris-Dakar Rally ended in this country's capital.
SWE|ABBA|ABBA won Eurovision with Waterloo while representing this country.
SWE|Alfred Nobel|Alfred Nobel, whose fortune funded the Nobel Prizes, was born here.
SWE|Minecraft|The video game Minecraft was created by Markus Persson in this country.
THA|Siam|This country was formerly known internationally as Siam.
THA|Songkran (Thailand)|Its Songkran New Year celebrations are famous for water splashing.
THA|The Beach (film)|The film The Beach used Maya Bay on Ko Phi Phi Le here.
TUN|Tunisian revolution|Protests here helped set off the Arab Spring in 2010–11.
TUN|Carthage|Ancient Carthage, Rome's great rival, stood near its modern capital.
TUN|Tataouine|Its desert locations helped portray Tatooine in the Star Wars films.
TUR|Mustafa Kemal Atatürk|Mustafa Kemal Atatürk founded its modern republic in 1923.
TUR|Hagia Sophia|Istanbul's Hagia Sophia began as a great Byzantine cathedral here.
TUR|Troy|The archaeological site associated with ancient Troy is here.
TZA|Freddie Mercury|Queen singer Freddie Mercury was born in Zanzibar, now part of this country.
TZA|Mount Kilimanjaro|Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest mountain, rises here.
TZA|Julius Nyerere|Julius Nyerere helped unite Tanganyika and Zanzibar into this country.
USA|Apollo 11|Its Apollo 11 mission landed the first people on the Moon.
USA|Martin Luther King Jr.|Martin Luther King Jr. delivered his I Have a Dream speech in its capital.
USA|Hollywood|Hollywood became the center of its internationally influential film industry.
UZB|Samarkand|Silk Road merchants passed through its city of Samarkand, famed for its tiled monuments.
UZB|Timur|The conqueror Timur made Samarkand his capital and was buried there.
UZB|1966 Tashkent earthquake|A devastating earthquake struck its capital Tashkent in 1966.
VNM|Fall of Saigon|The fall of Saigon in 1975 marked the end of a long war here.
VNM|Ho Chi Minh|Ho Chi Minh led its independence movement; its largest city now bears his name.
VNM|Pho|Phở, a soup of broth, rice noodles and herbs, originated here.
ZAF|Nelson Mandela|Nelson Mandela became its president after the first fully democratic national election in 1994.
ZAF|1995 Rugby World Cup final|Its Springboks won the 1995 Rugby World Cup, a moment later dramatized in Invictus.
ZAF|Desmond Tutu|Archbishop Desmond Tutu was a leading opponent of apartheid here.

KAZ|Astana|Its capital was renamed Nur-Sultan in 2019 and returned to the name Astana in 2022.
AZE|Eurovision Song Contest 2012|Baku hosted the Eurovision Song Contest in 2012 in this country.
AZE|Baku City Circuit|Formula One races through the streets of its capital Baku.
AZE|Gobustan State Historical and Cultural Reserve|Gobustan's ancient rock carvings record people, boats and animals near the Caspian Sea here.
MNG|Genghis Khan|Genghis Khan united nomadic tribes here before building an enormous empire.
MNG|Naadam|Its Naadam festival features wrestling, horse racing and archery.
MNG|Gobi Desert|Much of the Gobi Desert lies in this country, north of China.
MNE|2006 Montenegrin independence referendum|It voted for independence from its union with Serbia in 2006.
MNE|Casino Royale (2006 film)|The high-stakes poker tournament in Casino Royale is set in this country.
MNE|Bay of Kotor|Mountains surround the Bay of Kotor on its Adriatic coast.
BWA|The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency|The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency novels are set here.
BWA|Okavango Delta|The Okavango River spreads into a huge inland delta here instead of reaching the sea.

NAM|Namib|Its Namib Desert has some of the world's tallest sand dunes.

NAM|Mad Max: Fury Road|Much of Mad Max: Fury Road was filmed in its desert landscapes.
CRI|Public Force of Costa Rica|It abolished its standing army after a civil war in 1948.

EST|E-Residency of Estonia|It pioneered an e-residency program for people running businesses online.
BOL|Salar de Uyuni|The vast salt flat Salar de Uyuni is here.

BOL|Lake Titicaca|It shares Lake Titicaca with Peru.
ECU|Galápagos Islands|Darwin visited its Galápagos Islands during the voyage of HMS Beagle.

ECU|Panama hat|Despite their name, Panama hats are traditionally woven in this country.

GTM|Miguel Ángel Asturias|Nobel Prize-winning novelist Miguel Ángel Asturias came from this country.
URY|1930 FIFA World Cup|It hosted and won the first men's football World Cup in 1930.

URY|La cumparsita|The famous tango La Cumparsita was composed in its capital Montevideo.
JAM|Bob Marley|Bob Marley helped carry reggae from this island to the world.
JAM|Usain Bolt|Sprinter Usain Bolt won eight Olympic gold medals representing this country.
JAM|Cool Runnings|Cool Runnings was inspired by its team's debut in Olympic bobsleigh.
